sections.heading: Current loop
sections.text: Identical to NPC: dq-frame PI, crossover f_ci ~ fsw/10, dq decoupling, active damping for LCL filter. The T-type has different loss distribution (bidirectional switches carry more current during zero-level) but the control structure is the same.

sections.heading: Voltage loop
sections.text: DC-bus PI controller. Crossover f_cv ~ fsw/100. Anti-windup on current reference saturation. The voltage loop design is identical to NPC.

sections.heading: Neutral-point balancing loop
sections.text: Same balancing algorithm as NPC. The bidirectional neutral-point switches carry the balancing current — their current rating limits the balancing capability. Reduce balancing gain if the switches are thermally stressed.
